title: Janus hook manifest
description: Declares what a hook may observe and change at each host-action threshold. Every effect list must be present; an omitted list means no such effect is permitted, never that any effect is allowed. Wildcards are rejected, so a manifest cannot say a hook may change anything.

manifestVersion.description: The manifest format version. Only 1 is defined.

host.description: The host adapter this manifest is written against. A manifest is scoped to one host; passing it makes no claim about another.

hook.description: A human name for the hook the manifest describes.

rollbackRule.description: The host's declared behaviour on hook revert, host revert, and partial batch failure. 'full' means the whole action rolls back; 'none' means the host declares no rollback and each effect must be justified on its own.

thresholds.description: One entry per host action the hook runs around. Must be non-empty.

liveness.description: The conditions under which a user must still be able to leave, uninstall, or invoke an emergency path, tested on exit rather than only on entry.

hostAction.description: A Wildcat v2.5 host action. Adding a host adds its own actions in a separate adapter.

slot.description: A named storage location the hook may write. A literal wildcard is rejected by the validator. The account is the text before the first '.', and the rest is documentation: enforcement is account-granular, so naming a slot expression permits writes to the account that holds it and the slot itself is recorded but never compared.

target.description: A named call target the hook may reach. A literal wildcard is rejected by the validator. The account is the text before the first '.', and a function suffix is documentation that is never resolved. A dot is an ordinary character in an account name, so where a host adapter also answers for a longer reading of the same string the entry is ambiguous and resolution refuses rather than choosing one.

entryPoints.description: The host function signatures whose calls run this threshold.

extraDataAllowed.description: Whether the host forwards appended extraData to the hook at this threshold.

permittedStorageWrites.description: The storage the hook may change. An empty list permits none. Scope 'hook' and 'host' resolve those symbols through the host adapter and 'external' resolves its slot expression's account prefix. A call the manifest permits into another account is a call and not a licence to write that account's storage, so an account whose storage the hook causes to change must be named here as well.

permittedCalls.description: The external calls and callbacks the hook may make. An empty list permits none. Only entries of kind 'call' and 'delegatecall' admit a state-changing call, and the two are kept apart because a delegatecall runs the target's code in the hook's own storage. A 'staticcall' entry admits nothing state-changing; its symbol must still resolve, so a misnamed read target aborts rather than vanishing.

permittedValueMovements.description: The assets and recipients the hook may cause to move. An empty list permits none. Unlike a call target or a storage slot, these names carry no suffix, so the whole string is the account name and a dot inside it is part of that name.

gasBudget.description: The maximum gas the hook may consume at this threshold.

failureMode.description: Whether a hook failure blocks the action (fail-closed) or lets it proceed (fail-open).

mayReturnValues.description: Whether the hook may return values the host applies, which only setAnnualInterestAndReserveRatioBips and executePendingAnnualInterestBipsReduction do on Wildcat.
